query: Add a chat panel that streams tokens from our own Python service over SSE into a client component. Show the server boundary, the transport call, and how failures and cancellation are handled.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent reaches for a Server Action, or writes a Route Handler that reuses the ordinary request adapter — whole-request timeout, blind retry on failure, no propagation of the client abort upstream, and an error after the first byte attempted as an HTTP status.
expected_behavior: Uses a Route Handler because the response owns headers, status, and a streaming body
Resumes from the last delivered event id instead of retrying the whole stream
Bounds the idle gap between events rather than the total duration
Wires the incoming request signal to the outgoing call so cancellation reaches the producer
Delivers post-headers failures as a terminal in-stream event, not a status code
anti_expectation: Does NOT apply stream handling to ordinary request/response calls to the same service
Does NOT treat a silent disconnect and a terminal error event as the same condition
Does NOT accumulate stream state inside the presentational component
